summary: I pulled back on my lose deadlines. When I set "I care that you learn not when you learn" students simy did not do work. Classed with hard deadlines took precedent. This semester reading posts (snippets and quotes from reading) due on time except medical or emergency. Other assignments hand in on time and you get option to revise until you get grade you want
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I pulled back on my lose deadlines. When I set "I care that you learn not when you learn" students simy did not do work. Classed with hard deadlines took precedent.

This semester reading posts (snippets and quotes from reading) due on time except medical or emergency.

Other assignments hand in on time and you get option to revise until you get grade you want.

Hand in late and it is single submission only.
